    comps=[]; seen=set()

        stack=[c]; comp=[]

            p=stack.pop()
            if p in seen: continue
            seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
            for q in nb(p):

        comps.append(comp)

from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
